b:
My words
fail

I cast a net
to define him

but he is
like a carp
swimming and playing
in the wide ocean

Friendship
is his armour and earrings;

here even Indra
could not get them
on loan

He says the truth
out loud;
sometimes
he gives you
the salt with it

Even in salt
there is
nobility

He is
a black-bead necklace
full of
white flowers

There is nothing stopping you
from wearing it

Among a thousand beads
he shines
like a diamond

and in all
thousand beads,
here and there,
his
reflection

Lend him your shoulder;
he will give you his life

He,
the friend
note: In the Mahabharata, Karna was born with divine armour and earrings that made him invincible; Indra came disguised as a beggar and took them from him. A karugamani is a necklace of black beads.
